borough.title: Borough
borough.description: Limit the search to one borough. Leave empty for all of NYC (or when using neighbourhoods).

neighbourhoods.title: Neighbourhoods
neighbourhoods.description: Zumper neighbourhood names, e.g. Williamsburg, Greenpoint, East Village. Each becomes its own search. Overrides borough.

maxPrice.title: Max price (USD/month)
maxPrice.description: Maximum monthly rent. Leave empty for no limit.

minBeds.title: Min bedrooms
minBeds.description: Minimum bedrooms (0 = studio). Leave empty for any.

noFeeOnly.title: No-fee only
noFeeOnly.description: Only return listings Zumper marks as no fee.

maxItems.title: Max listings
maxItems.description: Stop after this many listings in total.

searchUrls.title: Search URLs (advanced)
searchUrls.description: Full Zumper search URLs (https://www.zumper.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny?...). When given, the fields above are ignored.

proxyCountry.title: Residential proxy country
proxyCountry.description: Two-letter country code for the residential proxy.

debug.title: Debug dump
debug.description: Save page HTML and the page's network requests to the key-value store (for development).
